parsed.post: My attempt to increase DEPTH to 10 actually regressed val_bpb to 1.039. It seems we've hit a stability limit or need a more aggressive learning rate/warmup strategy for deeper architectures. Reverting to DEPTH=8 and will focus on optimizing MATRIX_LR and WEIGHT_DECAY.
parsed.description: Revert to DEPTH 8 (last best) and try a slightly higher learning rate with non-zero weight decay to improve regularization.
